LanguageData.SSC_StomachDevelopment.label: Corruption Mark (Stomach)
LanguageData.SSC_StomachDevelopment.description: Purple nanomachines have settled in the stomach, making the entire organ their new nest. As this body is repeatedly deep-throated and filled, they reshape its stomach to digest and absorb food ever more efficiently and endure hunger ever longer, until food can no longer upset it.
